about: Link profiles for the mobile network-conditions harness (cmux-fault shaper.rs, scripts/measure/ios-network-conditions.sh). Each row is named and versioned: change a number, bump that row's version, and the report carries name@version so a before/after never compares two different links. Rates in kbit/s (0: unlimited), rtt_ms is the round trip (half each way), jitter_ms a seeded extra in 0..=jitter_ms per segment, loss_percent per 1460-byte segment each way.

profiles.name: good-wifi
profiles.source: Apple Network Link Conditioner preset 'WiFi' (Additional Tools for Xcode): 40 Mbps down, 33 Mbps up, 1 ms delay each way, 0% loss. The control row.

profiles.name: lte
profiles.source: WebPageTest connectivity profile 'LTE' (www/settings/connectivity.ini.sample, github.com/catchpoint/WebPageTest): 12 Mbps down, 12 Mbps up, 70 ms RTT. 0.5% loss per the lane brief (WebPageTest's row has 0 plr).

profiles.name: 5g-lte-handoff
profiles.source: The 'lte' row's link (low-band 5G NSA anchors on LTE; its higher peak rate does not move time to first content at these sizes), plus an address change mid-stream and a 1-3 s stall drawn from the seed, per the lane brief. Live connections go silent for good (the peer's packets go to the old address); new ones flow after the stall.

profiles.name: lossy-3
profiles.source: The 'lte' row's rate and RTT with 3% loss and 0-300 ms jitter per the lane brief.

profiles.name: lossy-10
profiles.source: Apple Network Link Conditioner preset 'Very Bad Network': 1 Mbps each way, 500 ms delay each way, 10% loss; plus 0-300 ms jitter per the lane brief.

profiles.name: elevator-30s
profiles.source: The 'lte' row's link, then 30 s with nothing through and the same link back, per the lane brief (the elevator). Bytes sent into the dark retransmit on TCP's doubling backoff (200 ms min RTO, RFC 6298), so recovery lands after the window, not at its end.

profiles.name: 2g-trickle
profiles.source: Rate: WebPageTest connectivity profile '56K Dial-Up' (49 kbps down, 30 kbps up), which is GPRS-grade (four CS-2 timeslots, 3GPP TS 45.003, are 53.6 kbit/s raw). RTT: WebPageTest profile '2G' (800 ms).
